Hi Ben,

I signed up for the Redwood trial this morning (CartPilot Inc.). We're evaluating a POC to replace a slow internal pipeline for cart summarization + product-level personalized recommendations. High-level details:

- Primary goal: reduce latency on cart insights and serve personalized recommendations at add-to-cart time.
- Expected volume for POC: ~50k requests/day, average payload ~80 tokens, expected peak bursts up to ~120 req/s.
- Timeline: aiming to start a 4–6 week POC next month; production decision after POC.

Would love a short walkthrough to confirm fit and get a sense of integration paths (API vs batch vs on-prem). If possible, can we do a 30-minute sync this week or early next week?

Thanks —
Sam

Ben — answers below inline. Thanks for the quick reply.

> 1) When you say 120 req/s peak, is that sustained for minutes or short spikes (seconds)?

Mostly short spikes around marketing drops — typically 30–90s bursts, but we've seen a minute or two sustained at worst.

> 2) What's the average and 95th percentile token length for prompts and responses?

Average combined tokens ~80; 95th ~220.

> 3) Do you anticipate needing embeddings/reranking alongside generation?

Yes — we'll likely use embeddings for semantic matching followed by a lightweight generation step for personalization.

> 4) Any data residency or PII constraints we should flag to our security team?

We do handle some hashed customer IDs and email hashes. No raw PII in payloads, but we'll need SOC2-level assurances and a data retention policy.

Timeline: We're targeting a POC start the week of 8/14, so a sync this week would help us lock resources. Can we do Wed 7/31 10:00 PT (your first option)? Asha (cc'd) will join on the infra side.

I've attached a quick traffic snapshot for context.

Best,
Sam
